sections.title: Pegi Flahault, *a small business owner just like you*
body: m.o.m. specializes in the one-person or home-based business that needs help with paperwork and business details on an occasional or project basis. You get hands-on assistance from the same person each time, with a network of professionals who can be brought in when a project needs them.

Pegi brings 25 years of corporate experience, from file clerk to corporate officer, and more than 20 years running her own one-person business. She is an active member of the Greater Aiken Chamber of Commerce and a Chamber Ambassador.

quote.text: I could do the bookkeeping and administrative functions, but it would take me much longer, and my time and skills are best spent on marketing and running the business.
quote.by: Kelly MacVean, LaDolce Gourmet Bakery, Coffee & Tea Bar
